1.zh: 约书亚死后，以色列人求问耶和华说：「我们中间谁当首先上去攻击迦南人，与他们争战？」
1.en: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

1.zh: 耶和华说：「犹大当先上去，我已将那地交在他手中。」
1.en: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

1.zh: 犹大对他哥哥西缅说：「请你同我到拈阄所得之地去，好与迦南人争战；以后我也同你到你拈阄所得之地去。」于是西缅与他同去。
1.en: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

1.zh: 犹大就上去；耶和华将迦南人和比利洗人交在他们手中。他们在比色击杀了一万人，
1.en: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

1.zh: 又在那里遇见亚多尼·比色，与他争战，杀败迦南人和比利洗人。
1.en: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

1.zh: 亚多尼·比色逃跑；他们追赶，拿住他，砍断他手脚的大拇指。
1.en: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

1.zh: 亚多尼·比色说：「从前有七十个王，手脚的大拇指都被[我]砍断，在我桌子底下拾取[零碎食物]。现在　神按着我所行的报应我了。」于是他们将亚多尼·比色带到耶路撒冷，他就死在那里。
1.en: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

1.zh: 犹大人攻打耶路撒冷，将城攻取，用刀杀了城内的人，并且放火烧城。
1.en: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

1.zh: 后来犹大人下去，与住山地、南地，和高原的迦南人争战。
1.en: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

1.zh: 犹大人去攻击住希伯 的迦南人，杀了示筛、亚希幔、挞买。希伯 从前名叫基列·亚巴。
1.en: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

1.zh: 他们从那里去攻击底壁的居民；底壁从前名叫基列·西弗。
1.en: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

1.zh: 迦勒说：「谁能攻打基列·西弗，将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。」
1.en: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”

1.zh: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。
1.en: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

1.zh: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田。押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说：「你要什么？」
1.en: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

1.zh: 她说：「求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。」迦勒就把上泉下泉赐给她。
1.en: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

1.zh: 摩西的内兄是基尼人，他的子孙与犹大人一同离了棕树城，往亚拉得以南的犹大旷野去，就住在民中。
1.en: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

1.zh: 犹大和他哥哥西缅同去，击杀了住洗法的迦南人，将城尽行毁灭，那城的名便叫何珥玛。
1.en: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

1.zh: 犹大又取了迦萨和迦萨的四境，亚实基伦和亚实基伦的四境，以革伦和以革伦的四境。
1.en: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

1.zh: 耶和华与犹大同在，犹大就赶出山地的[居民]，只是不能赶出平原的居民，因为他们有铁车。
1.en: The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

1.zh: 以色列人照摩西所说的，将希伯 给了迦勒；迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长。
1.en: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

1.zh: 便雅悯人没有赶出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷与便雅悯人同住，直到今日。
1.en: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

1.zh: 约瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和华与他们同在。
1.en: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

1.zh: 约瑟家打发人去窥探伯特利（那城起先名叫路斯）。
1.en: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)

1.zh: 窥探的人看见一个人从城里出来，就对他说：「求你将进城的路指示我们，我们必恩待你。」
1.en: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”

1.zh: 那人将进城的路指示他们，他们就用刀击杀了城中的居民，但将那人和他全家放去。
1.en: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

1.zh: 那人往赫人之地去，筑了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今还叫这名。
1.en: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

1.zh: 玛拿西没有赶出伯·善和属伯·善乡村的[居民]，他纳和属他纳乡村的[居民]，多珥和属多珥乡村的居民，以伯莲和属以伯莲乡村的居民，米吉多和属米吉多乡村的居民；迦南人却执意住在那些地方。
1.en: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

1.zh: 及至以色列强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。
1.en: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

1.zh: 以法莲没有赶出住基色的迦南人。于是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法莲中间。
1.en: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

1.zh: 西布伦没有赶出基伦的居民和拿哈拉的居民。于是迦南人仍住在西布伦中间，成了服苦的人。
1.en: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.

1.zh: 亚设没有赶出亚柯和西顿的居民，亚黑拉和亚革悉的居民，黑巴、亚弗革与利合的居民。
1.en: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

1.zh: 于是，亚设因为没有赶出那地的迦南人，就住在他们中间。
1.en: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

1.zh: 拿弗他利没有赶出伯·示麦和伯·亚纳的居民，于是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中间；然而伯·示麦和伯·亚纳的居民成了服苦的人。
1.en: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

1.zh: 亚摩利人强逼但人住在山地，不容他们下到平原；
1.en: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;

1.zh: 亚摩利人却执意住在希烈山和亚雅 并沙宾。然而约瑟家胜了他们，使他们成了服苦的人。
1.en: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.

1.zh: 亚摩利人的境界，是从亚克拉滨坡，从西拉而上。
1.en: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

2.zh: 耶和华的使者从吉甲上到波金，对[以色列]人说：「我使你们从埃及上来，领你们到我向你们列祖起誓应许之地。我又说：『我永不废弃与你们所立的约。
2.en: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

2.zh: 你们也不可与这地的居民立约，要拆毁他们的祭坛。你们竟没有听从我的话！为何这样行呢？』
2.en: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

2.zh: 因此我又说：『我必不将他们从你们面前赶出；他们必作你们肋下的[荆棘]。他们的神必作你们的网罗。』」
2.en: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

2.zh: 耶和华的使者向以色列众人说这话的时候，百姓就放声而哭；
2.en: When the LORD’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

2.zh: 于是给那地方起名叫波金。众人在那里向耶和华献祭。
2.en: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to the LORD.

2.zh: 从前约书亚打发以色列百姓去的时候，他们各归自己的地业，占据地土。
2.en: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

2.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些见耶和华为以色列人所行大事的长老还在的时候，百姓都事奉耶和华。
2.en: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the LORD that he had worked for Israel.

2.zh: 耶和华的仆人、嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁就死了。
2.en: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

2.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿·希烈，在迦实山的北边。
2.en: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

2.zh: 那世代的人也都归了自己的列祖。后来有别的世代兴起，不知道耶和华，也不知道耶和华为以色列人所行的事。
2.en: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

2.zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力，
2.en: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.

2.zh: 离弃了领他们出埃及地的耶和华—他们列祖的　神，去叩拜别神，就是四围列国的神，惹耶和华发怒；
2.en: They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.

2.zh: 并离弃耶和华，去事奉巴力和亚斯她录。
2.en: They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

2.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，又将他们付与四围仇敌的手中，甚至他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。
2.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

2.zh: 他们无论往何处去，耶和华都以灾祸攻击他们，正如耶和华所说的话，又如耶和华向他们所起的誓；他们便极其困苦。
2.en: Wherever they went out, the LORD’s hand was against them for evil, as the LORD had spoken, and as the LORD had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

2.zh: 耶和华兴起士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢夺他们人的手。
2.en: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

2.zh: 他们却不听从士师，竟随从叩拜别神，行了邪淫，速速地偏离他们列祖所行的道，不如他们列祖顺从耶和华的命令。
2.en: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying the LORD’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

2.zh: 耶和华为他们兴起士师，就与那士师同在。士师在世的一切日子，耶和华拯救他们脱离仇敌的手。他们因受欺压扰害，就哀声叹气，所以耶和华后悔了。
2.en: When the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

2.zh: 及至士师死后，他们就转去行恶，比他们列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜别神，总不断绝顽梗的恶行。
2.en: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

2.zh: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作。他说：「因这民违背我吩咐他们列祖所守的约，不听从我的话，
2.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

2.zh: 所以约书亚死的时候所剩下的各族，我必不再从他们面前赶出，
2.en: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

2.zh: 为要借此试验以色列人，看他们肯照他们列祖谨守遵行我的道不肯。」
2.en: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep the LORD’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

2.zh: 这样耶和华留下各族，不将他们速速赶出，也没有交付约书亚的手。
2.en: So the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

3.zh: 耶和华留下这几族，为要试验那不曾知道与迦南争战之事的以色列人，
3.en: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

3.zh: 好叫以色列的后代又知道又学习未曾晓得的战事。
3.en: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

3.zh: 所[留下的]就是非利士的五个首领和一切迦南人、西顿人，并住黎巴嫩山的希未人，从巴力·黑们山直到哈马口。
3.en: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

3.zh: 留[下]这几族，为要试验以色列人，知道他们肯听从耶和华借摩西吩咐他们列祖的诫命不肯。
3.en: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

3.zh: 以色列人竟住在迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中间，
3.en: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

3.zh: 娶他们的女儿为妻，将自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，并事奉他们的神。
3.en: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

3.zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，忘记耶和华—他们的　神，去事奉诸巴力和亚舍拉，
3.en: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

3.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在美索不达米亚王古珊·利萨田的手中。以色列人服事古珊·利萨田八年。
3.en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

3.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者救他们，就是迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂。
3.en: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

3.zh: 耶和华的灵降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士师，出去争战。耶和华将美索不达米亚王古珊·利萨田交在他手中，他便胜了古珊·利萨田。
3.en: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

3.zh: 于是国中太平四十年。基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂死了。
3.en: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

3.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛，攻击以色列人。
3.en: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

3.zh: 伊矶伦招聚亚扪人和亚玛力人，去攻打以色列人，占据棕树城。
3.en: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

3.zh: 于是以色列人服事摩押王伊矶伦十八年。
3.en: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

3.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人托他送礼物给摩押王伊矶伦。
3.en: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

3.zh: 以笏打了一把两刃的剑，长一肘，带在右腿上衣服里面。
3.en: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

3.zh: 他将礼物献给摩押王伊矶伦（原来伊矶伦极其肥胖）；
3.en: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

3.zh: 以笏献完礼物，便将抬礼物的人打发走了，
3.en: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

3.zh: 自己却从靠近吉甲凿石之地回来，说：「王啊，我有一件机密事奏告你。」王说：「回避吧！」于是左右侍立的人都退去了。
3.en: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

3.zh: 以笏来到王面前；王独自一人坐在凉楼上。以笏说：「我奉　神的命报告你一件事。」王就从座位上站起来。
3.en: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

3.zh: 以笏便伸左手，从右腿上拔出剑来，刺入王的肚腹，
3.en: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

3.zh: 连剑把都刺进去了。剑被肥肉夹住，他没有从王的肚腹拔出来，且穿通了后身。
3.en: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

3.zh: 以笏就出到游廊，将楼门尽都关锁。
3.en: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

3.zh: 以笏出来之后，王的仆人到了，看见楼门关锁，就说：「他必是在楼上大解。」
3.en: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

3.zh: 他们等烦了，见仍不开楼门，就拿钥匙开了，不料，他们的主人已死，倒在地上。
3.en: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

3.zh: 他们耽延的时候，以笏就逃跑了，经过凿石之地，逃到西伊拉；
3.en: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

3.zh: 到了，就在以法莲山地吹角。以色列人随着他下了山地，他在前头引路，
3.en: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

3.zh: 对他们说：「你们随我来，因为耶和华已经把你们的仇敌摩押人交在你们手中。」于是他们跟着他下去，把守约旦河的渡口，不容摩押一人过去。
3.en: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

3.zh: 那时击杀了摩押人约有一万，都是强壮的勇士，没有一人逃脱。
3.en: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

3.zh: 这样，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。国中太平八十年。
3.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

3.zh: 以笏之后，有亚拿的儿子珊迦，他用赶牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。
3.en: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

4.zh: 以笏死后，以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，
4.en: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

4.zh: 耶和华就把他们付与在夏琐作王的迦南王耶宾手中；他的将军是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏罗设。
4.en: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

4.zh: 耶宾王有铁车九百辆。他大大欺压以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和华。
4.en: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

4.zh: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，当时作以色列的士师。
4.en: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

4.zh: 她住在以法莲山地拉玛和伯特利中间，在底波拉的棕树下。以色列人都上她那里去听判断。
4.en: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

4.zh: 她打发人从拿弗他利的基低斯将亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉召了来，对他说：「耶和华—以色列的　神吩咐你说：『你率领一万拿弗他利和西布伦人上他泊山去。
4.en: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

4.zh: 我必使耶宾的将军西西拉率领他的车辆和全军往基顺河，到你那里去；我必将他交在你手中。』」
4.en: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

4.zh: 巴拉说：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」
4.en: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

4.zh: 底波拉说：「我必与你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不着荣耀，因为耶和华要将西西拉交在一个妇人手里。」于是底波拉起来，与巴拉一同往基低斯去了。
4.en: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for the LORD will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

4.zh: 巴拉就招聚西布伦人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一万人。底波拉也同他上去。
4.en: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

4.zh: 摩西岳父何巴的后裔，基尼人希百曾离开基尼族，到靠近基低斯、撒拿音的橡树旁支搭帐棚。
4.en: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

4.zh: 有人告诉西西拉说：「亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉已经上他泊山了。」
4.en: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

4.zh: 西西拉就聚集所有的铁车九百辆和跟随他的全军，从外邦人的夏罗设出来，到了基顺河。
4.en: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

4.zh: 底波拉对巴拉说：「你起来，今日就是耶和华将西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和华岂不在你前头行吗？」于是巴拉下了他泊山，跟随他有一万人。
4.en: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t the LORD gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

4.zh: 耶和华使西西拉和他一切车辆全军溃乱，在巴拉面前被刀杀败；西西拉下车步行逃跑。
4.en: The LORD confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

4.zh: 巴拉追赶车辆、军队，直到外邦人的夏罗设。西西拉的全军都倒在刀下，没有留下一人。
4.en: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

4.zh: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅亿的帐棚，因为夏琐王耶宾与基尼人希百家和好。
4.en: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

4.zh: 雅亿出来迎接西西拉，对他说：「请我主进来，不要惧怕」；西西拉就进了她的帐棚。雅亿用被将他遮盖。
4.en: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

4.zh: 西西拉对雅亿说：「我渴了，求你给我一点水喝。」雅亿就打开皮袋，给他奶子喝，仍旧把他遮盖。
4.en: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

4.zh: 西西拉又对雅亿说：「请你站在帐棚门口，若有人来问你说：『有人在这里没有？』你就说：『没有。』」
4.en: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

4.zh: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅亿取了帐棚的橛子，手里拿着锤子，轻悄悄地到他旁边，将橛子从他鬓边钉进去，钉入地里。西西拉就死了。
4.en: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

4.zh: 巴拉追赶西西拉的时候，雅亿出来迎接他说：「来吧，我将你所寻找的人给你看。」他就进入帐棚，看见西西拉已经死了，倒在地上，橛子还在他鬓中。
4.en: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

4.zh: 这样，　神使迦南王耶宾被以色列人制伏了。
4.en: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

4.zh: 从此以色列人的手越发有力，胜了迦南王耶宾，直到将他灭绝了。
4.en: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

5.zh: 那时，底波拉和亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉作歌，说：
5.en: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

5.zh: 因为以色列中有军长率领， 百姓也甘心牺牲自己， 你们应当颂赞耶和华！
5.en: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, LORD!

5.zh: 君王啊，要听！ 王子啊，要侧耳而听！ 我要向耶和华歌唱； 我要歌颂耶和华—以色列的　神。
5.en: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to the LORD. I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.

5.zh: 耶和华啊，你从西珥出来， 由以东地行走。 那时地震天漏， 云也落[雨]。
5.en: “LORD, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.

5.zh: 山见耶和华的面就震动， 西奈山见耶和华—以色列　神的面也是如此。
5.en: The mountains quaked at the LORD’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel.

5.zh: 在亚拿之子珊迦的时候， 又在雅亿的日子， 大道无人行走， 都是绕道而行。
5.en: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.

5.zh: 以色列中的官长停职， 直到我底波拉兴起， 等我兴起作以色列的母。
5.en: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.

5.zh: 以色列人选择新神， 争战的事就临到城门。 那时，以色列四万人中 岂能见盾牌枪矛呢？
5.en: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

5.zh: 我心倾向以色列的首领， 他们在民中甘心牺牲自己。 你们应当颂赞耶和华！
5.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD!

5.zh: 骑白驴的、坐绣花毯子的、行路的， 你们都当传扬！
5.en: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.

5.zh: 在远离弓箭响声打水之处， 人必述说耶和华公义的作为， 就是他治理以色列公义的作为。 那时耶和华的民下到城门。
5.en: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse the LORD’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then the LORD’s people went down to the gates.

5.zh: 底波拉啊，兴起！兴起！ 你当兴起，兴起，唱歌。 亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉啊，你当奋兴， 掳掠你的敌人。
5.en: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’

5.zh: 那时有余剩的贵胄和百姓一同下来； 耶和华降临，为我攻击勇士。
5.en: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. The LORD came down for me against the mighty.

5.zh: 有根本在亚玛力[人的地]， 从以法莲[下来]的； 便雅悯在民中跟随你。 有掌权的从玛吉下来； 有持杖检点民数的从西布伦下来；
5.en: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.

5.zh: 以萨迦的首领与底波拉同来； 以萨迦怎样，巴拉也怎样。 众人都跟随巴拉冲下平原； 在吕便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。
5.en: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.

5.zh: 你为何坐在羊圈内 听群中吹笛的声音呢？ 在吕便的溪水旁有心中设大谋的。
5.en: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.

5.zh: 基列人安居在约旦河外。 但人为何等在船上？ 亚设人在海口静坐， 在港口安居。
5.en: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.

5.zh: 西布伦人是拚命敢死的； 拿弗他利人在田野的高处也是如此。
5.en: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.

5.zh: 君王都来争战。 那时迦南诸王在米吉多水旁的他纳争战， 却未得掳掠银钱。
5.en: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.

5.zh: 星宿从天上争战， 从其轨道攻击西西拉。
5.en: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.

5.zh: 基顺古河把敌人冲没； 我的灵啊，应当努力前行。
5.en: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.

5.zh: 那时壮马驰驱， 踢跳，奔腾。
5.en: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.

5.zh: 耶和华的使者说： 应当咒诅米罗斯， 大大咒诅其中的居民； 因为他们不来帮助耶和华， 不来帮助耶和华攻击勇士。
5.en: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the LORD’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’

5.zh: 愿基尼人希百的妻雅亿比众妇人多得福气， 比住帐棚的妇人更蒙福祉。
5.en: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

5.zh: 西西拉求水， 雅亿给他奶子， 用宝贵的盘子给他奶油。
5.en: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.

5.zh: 雅亿左手拿着帐棚的橛子， 右手拿着匠人的锤子， 击打西西拉， 打伤他的头， 把他的鬓角打破穿通。
5.en: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.

5.zh: 西西拉在她脚前曲身仆倒， 在她脚前曲身倒卧； 在那里曲身，就在那里死亡。
5.en: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

5.zh: 西西拉的母亲从窗户里往外观看， 从窗棂中呼叫说： 他的战车为何耽延不来呢？ 他的车轮为何行得慢呢？
5.en: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’

5.zh: 聪明的宫女安慰她， 她也自言自语地说：
5.en: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,

5.zh: 他们莫非得财而分？ 每人得了一两个女子？ 西西拉得了彩衣为掳物， 得绣花的彩衣为掠物。 这彩衣两面绣花， 乃是披在被掳之人颈项上的。
5.en: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’

5.zh: 耶和华啊， 愿你的仇敌都这样灭亡！ 愿爱你的人如日头出现，光辉烈烈！ 这样，国中太平四十年。
5.en: “So let all your enemies perish, LORD, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.

6.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就把他们交在米甸人手里七年。
6.en: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, so the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

6.zh: 米甸人压制以色列人；以色列人因为米甸人，就在山中挖穴、挖洞、建造营寨。
6.en: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

6.zh: 以色列人每逢撒种之后，米甸人、亚玛力人，和东方人都上来攻打他们，
6.en: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

6.zh: 对着他们安营，毁坏土产，直到迦萨，没有给以色列人留下食物，牛、羊、驴也没有留下；
6.en: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.

6.zh: 因为那些人带着牲畜帐棚来，像蝗虫那样多，人和骆驼无数，都进入国内，毁坏全地。
6.en: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.

6.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的缘故，极其穷乏，就呼求耶和华。
6.en: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD.

6.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的缘故，呼求耶和华，
6.en: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of Midian,

6.zh: 耶和华就差遣先知到以色列人那里，对他们说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『我曾领你们从埃及上来，出了为奴之家，
6.en: The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

6.zh: 救你们脱离埃及人的手，并脱离一切欺压你们之人的手，把他们从你们面前赶出，将他们的地赐给你们』；
6.en: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.

6.zh: 又对你们说：『我是耶和华—你们的　神。你们住在亚摩利人的地，不可敬畏他们的神。你们竟不听从我的话。』」
6.en: I said to you, “I am the LORD your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”

6.zh: 耶和华的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亚比以谢族人约阿施的橡树下。约阿施的儿子基甸正在酒榨那里打麦子，为要防备米甸人。
6.en: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

6.zh: 耶和华的使者向基甸显现，对他说：「大能的勇士啊，耶和华与你同在！」
6.en: The LORD’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

6.zh: 基甸说：「主啊，耶和华若与我们同在，我们何至遭遇这一切事呢？我们的列祖不是向我们说『耶和华领我们从埃及上来』吗？他那样奇妙的作为在哪里呢？现在他却丢弃我们，将我们交在米甸人手里。」
6.en: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t the LORD bring us up from Egypt?’ But now the LORD has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

6.zh: 耶和华观看基甸，说：「你靠着你这能力去从米甸人手里拯救以色列人，不是我差遣你去的吗？」
6.en: The LORD looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”

6.zh: 基甸说：「主啊，我有何能拯救以色列人呢？我家在玛拿西支派中是至贫穷的。我在我父家是至微小的。」
6.en: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”

6.zh: 耶和华对他说：「我与你同在，你就必击打米甸人，如击打一人一样。」
6.en: The LORD said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”

6.zh: 基甸说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你给我一个证据，使我知道与我说话的就是主。
6.en: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.

6.zh: 求你不要离开这里，等我归回将礼物带来供在你面前。」主说：「我必等你回来。」
6.en: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”

6.zh: 基甸去预备了一只山羊羔，用一伊法细面做了无酵饼，将肉放在筐内，把汤盛在壶中，带到橡树下，献在使者面前。
6.en: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

6.zh: 神的使者吩咐基甸说：「将肉和无酵饼放在这磐石上，把汤倒出来。」他就这样行了。
6.en: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.

6.zh: 耶和华的使者伸出手内的杖，杖头挨了肉和无酵饼，就有火从磐石中出来，烧尽了肉和无酵饼。耶和华的使者也就不见了。
6.en: Then the LORD’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then the LORD’s angel departed out of his sight.

6.zh: 基甸见他是耶和华的使者，就说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，我不好了，因为我觌面看见耶和华的使者。」
6.en: Gideon saw that he was the LORD’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord GOD! Because I have seen the LORD’s angel face to face!”

6.zh: 耶和华对他说：「你放心，不要惧怕，你必不至死。」
6.en: The LORD said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”

6.zh: 于是基甸在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，起名叫「耶和华沙龙」。（这坛在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉直到如今。）
6.en: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it “The LORD is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

6.zh: 当那夜，耶和华吩咐基甸说：「你取你父亲的牛来，就是那七岁的第二只牛，并拆毁你父亲为巴力所筑的坛，砍下坛旁的木偶，
6.en: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.

6.zh: 在这磐石上整整齐齐地为耶和华—你的　神筑一座坛，将第二只牛献为燔祭，用你所砍下的木偶作柴。」
6.en: Then build an altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

6.zh: 基甸就从他仆人中挑了十个人，照着耶和华吩咐他的行了。他因怕父家和本城的人，不敢在白昼行这事，就在夜间行了。
6.en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.

6.zh: 城里的人清早起来，见巴力的坛拆毁，坛旁的木偶砍下，第二只牛献在新筑的坛上，
6.en: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

6.zh: 就彼此说：「这事是谁做的呢？」他们访查之后，就说：「这是约阿施的儿子基甸做的。」
6.en: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”

6.zh: 城里的人对约阿施说：「将你儿子交出来，好治死他；因为他拆毁了巴力的坛，砍下坛旁的木偶。」
6.en: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”

6.zh: 约阿施回答站着攻击他的众人说：「你们是为巴力争论吗？你们要救他吗？谁为他争论，趁早将谁治死！巴力若果是神，有人拆毁他的坛，让他为自己争论吧！」
6.en: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

6.zh: 所以当日人称基甸为耶路·巴力，意思说：「他拆毁巴力的坛，让巴力与他争论。」
6.en: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”

6.zh: 那时，米甸人、亚玛力人，和东方人都聚集过河，在耶斯列平原安营。
6.en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

6.zh: 耶和华的灵降在基甸身上，他就吹角；亚比以谢族都聚集跟随他。
6.en: But the LORD’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.

6.zh: 他打发人走遍玛拿西地，玛拿西人也聚集跟随他；又打发人去见亚设人、西布伦人、拿弗他利人，他们也都出来与他们会合。
6.en: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

6.zh: 基甸对　神说：「你若果照着所说的话，借我手拯救以色列人，
6.en: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

6.zh: 我就把一团羊毛放在禾场上：若单是羊毛上有露水，别的地方都是干的，我就知道你必照着所说的话，借我手拯救以色列人。」
6.en: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”

6.zh: 次日早晨基甸起来，见果然是这样；将羊毛挤一挤，从羊毛中拧出满盆的露水来。
6.en: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

6.zh: 基甸又对　神说：「求你不要向我发怒，我再说这一次：让我将羊毛再试一次。但愿羊毛是干的，别的地方都有露水。」
6.en: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”

6.zh: 这夜　神也如此行：独羊毛上是干的，别的地方都有露水。
6.en: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

7.zh: 耶路·巴力就是基甸，他和一切跟随的人早晨起来，在哈律泉旁安营。米甸营在他们北边的平原，靠近摩利冈。
7.en: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

7.zh: 耶和华对基甸说：「跟随你的人过多，我不能将米甸人交在他们手中，免得以色列人向我夸大，说：『是我们自己的手救了我们。』
7.en: The LORD said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

7.zh: 现在你要向这些人宣告说：『凡惧怕胆怯的，可以离开基列山回去。』」于是有二万二千人回去，只剩下一万。
7.en: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

7.zh: 耶和华对基甸说：「人还是过多；你要带他们下到水旁，我好在那里为你试试他们。我指点谁说：『这人可以同你去』，他就可以同你去；我指点谁说：『这人不可同你去』，他就不可同你去。」
7.en: The LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”

7.zh: 基甸就带他们下到水旁。耶和华对基甸说：「凡用舌头舔水，像狗舔的，要使他单站在一处；凡跪下喝水的，也要使他单站在一处。」
7.en: So he brought down the people to the water; and the LORD said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”

7.zh: 于是用手捧着舔水的有三百人，其余的都跪下喝水。
7.en: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.

7.zh: 耶和华对基甸说：「我要用这舔水的三百人拯救你们，将米甸人交在你手中；其余的人都可以各归各处去。」
7.en: The LORD said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”

7.zh: 这三百人就带着食物和角；其余的以色列人，基甸都打发他们各归各的帐棚，只留下这三百人。米甸营在他下边的平原里。
7.en: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

7.zh: 当那夜，耶和华吩咐基甸说：「起来，下到[米甸]营里去，因我已将他们交在你手中。
7.en: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

7.zh: 倘若你怕下去，就带你的仆人普拉下到那营里去。
7.en: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.

7.zh: 你必听见他们所说的，然后你就有胆量下去攻营。」于是基甸带着仆人普拉下到营旁。
7.en: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.

7.zh: 米甸人、亚玛力人，和一切东方人都布散在平原，如同蝗虫那样多。他们的骆驼无数，多如海边的沙。
7.en: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

7.zh: 基甸到了，就听见一人将梦告诉同伴说：「我做了一梦，梦见一个大麦饼滚入米甸营中，到了帐幕，将帐幕撞倒，帐幕就翻转倾覆了。」
7.en: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”

7.zh: 那同伴说：「这不是别的，乃是以色列人约阿施的儿子基甸的刀；　神已将米甸和全军都交在他的手中。」
7.en: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”

7.zh: 基甸听见这梦和梦的讲解，就敬拜　[神]，回到以色列营中，说：「起来吧！耶和华已将米甸的军队交在你们手中了。」
7.en: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for the LORD has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

7.zh: 于是基甸将三百人分作三队，把角和空瓶交在各人手里（瓶内都藏着火把），
7.en: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

7.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们要看我行事：我到了营的旁边怎样行，你们也要怎样行。
7.en: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

7.zh: 我和一切跟随我的人吹角的时候，你们也要在营的四围吹角，[喊叫]说：『耶和华和基甸[的刀]！』」
7.en: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’”

7.zh: 基甸和跟随他的一百人，在三更之初才换更的时候，来到营旁，就吹角，打破手中的瓶。
7.en: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.

7.zh: 三队的人就都吹角，打破瓶子，左手拿着火把，右手拿着角，喊叫说：「耶和华和基甸的刀！」
7.en: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of the LORD and of Gideon!”

7.zh: 他们在营的四围各站各的地方；全营的人都乱窜。三百人呐喊，使他们逃跑。
7.en: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.

7.zh: 三百人就吹角，耶和华使全营的人用刀互相击杀，逃到西利拉的伯·哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亚伯·米何拉。
7.en: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

7.zh: 以色列人就从拿弗他利、亚设，和玛拿西全地聚集来追赶米甸人。
7.en: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.

7.zh: 基甸打发人走遍以法莲山地，说：「你们下来攻击米甸人，争先把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯·巴拉。」于是以法莲的众人聚集，把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯·巴拉，
7.en: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

7.zh: 捉住了米甸人的两个首领：一名俄立，一名西伊伯；将俄立杀在俄立磐石上，将西伊伯杀在西伊伯酒榨那里；又追赶米甸人，将俄立和西伊伯的首级带过约旦河，到基甸那里。
7.en: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.

8.zh: 以法莲人对基甸说：「你去与米甸人争战，没有招我们同去，为什么这样待我们呢？」他们就与基甸大大地争吵。
8.en: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

8.zh: 基甸对他们说：「我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？以法莲拾取剩下的葡萄不强过亚比以谢所摘的葡萄吗？
8.en: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

8.zh: 神已将米甸人的两个首领俄立和西伊伯交在你们手中；我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？」基甸说了这话，以法莲人的怒气就消了。
8.en: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

8.zh: 基甸和跟随他的三百人到约旦河过渡，虽然疲乏，还是追赶。
8.en: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.

8.zh: 基甸对疏割人说：「求你们拿饼来给跟随我的人吃，因为他们疲乏了；我们追赶米甸人的两个王西巴和撒慕拿。」
8.en: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

8.zh: 疏割人的首领回答说：「西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给你的军兵吗？」
8.en: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

8.zh: 基甸说：「耶和华将西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之后，我就用野地的荆条和枳棘打伤你们。」
8.en: Gideon said, “Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

8.zh: 基甸从那里上到毗努伊勒，对那里的人也是这样说；毗努伊勒人也与疏割人回答他的话一样。
8.en: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.

8.zh: 他向毗努伊勒人说：「我平平安安回来的时候，我必拆毁这楼。」
8.en: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

8.zh: 那时西巴和撒慕拿，并跟随他们的军队都在加各，约有一万五千人，就是东方人全军所剩下的；已经被杀约有十二万拿刀的。
8.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.

8.zh: 基甸就由挪巴和约比哈东边，从住帐棚人的路上去，杀败了米甸人的军兵，因为他们坦然无惧。
8.en: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.

8.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追赶他们，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，惊散全军。
8.en: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.

8.zh: 约阿施的儿子基甸由希列斯坡从阵上回来，
8.en: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.

8.zh: 捉住疏割的一个少年人，问他：「疏割的首领长老是谁？」他就将首领长老七十七个人的名字写出来。
8.en: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

8.zh: 基甸到了疏割，对那里的人说：「你们从前讥诮我说：『西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给[跟随]你的疲乏人吗？』现在西巴和撒慕拿在这里。」
8.en: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”

8.zh: 于是捉住那城内的长老，用野地的荆条和枳棘责打疏割人；
8.en: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

8.zh: 又拆了毗努伊勒的楼，杀了那城里的人。
8.en: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

8.zh: 基甸问西巴和撒慕拿说：「你们在他泊山所杀的人是什么样式？」回答说：「他们好像你，各人都有王子的样式。」
8.en: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”

8.zh: 基甸说：「他们是我同母的弟兄，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们从前若存留他们的性命，我如今就不杀你们了。」
8.en: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”

8.zh: 于是对他的长子益帖说：「你起来杀他们。」但益帖因为是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。
8.en: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

8.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿说：「你自己起来杀我们吧！因为人如何，力量也是如何。」基甸就起来，杀了西巴和撒慕拿，夺获他们骆驼项上戴的月牙圈。
8.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.

8.zh: 以色列人对基甸说：「你既救我们脱离米甸人的手，愿你和你的儿孙管理我们。」
8.en: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”

8.zh: 基甸说：「我不管理你们，我的儿子也不管理你们，惟有耶和华管理你们。」
8.en: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. The LORD shall rule over you.”

8.zh: 基甸又对他们说：「我有一件事求你们：请你们各人将所夺的耳环给我。」（原来仇敌是以实玛利人，都是戴金耳环的。）
8.en: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

8.zh: 他们说：「我们情愿给你」，就铺开一件外衣，各人将所夺的耳环丢在其上。
8.en: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.

8.zh: 基甸所要出来的金耳环重一千七百[舍客勒]金子。此外还有米甸王所戴的月环、耳坠，和所穿的紫色衣服，并骆驼项上的[金]链子。
8.en: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

8.zh: 基甸以此制造了一个以弗得，设立在本城俄弗拉。后来以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫；这就作了基甸和他全家的网罗。
8.en: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

8.zh: 这样，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬头。基甸还在的日子，国中太平四十年。
8.en: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

8.zh: 约阿施的儿子耶路·巴力回去，住在自己家里。
8.en: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

8.zh: 基甸有七十个亲生的儿子，因为他有许多的妻。
8.en: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

8.zh: 他的妾住在示剑，也给他生了一个儿子。基甸与他起名叫亚比米勒。
8.en: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

8.zh: 约阿施的儿子基甸，年纪老迈而死，葬在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉，在他父亲约阿施的坟墓里。
8.en: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

8.zh: 基甸死后，以色列人又去随从诸巴力行邪淫，以巴力·比利土为他们的神。
8.en: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.

8.zh: 以色列人不记念耶和华—他们的　神，就是拯救他们脱离四围仇敌之手的，
8.en: The children of Israel didn’t remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;

8.zh: 也不照着耶路·巴力，就是基甸向他们所施的恩惠厚待他的家。
8.en: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

9.zh: 耶路·巴力的儿子亚比米勒到了示剑见他的众母舅，对他们和他外祖全家的人说：
9.en: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

9.zh: 「请你们问示剑的众人说，是耶路·巴力的众子七十人都管理你们好呢？还是一人管理你们好呢？你们又要记念我是你们的骨肉。」
9.en: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”

9.zh: 他的众母舅便将这一切话为他说给示剑人听，示剑人的心就归向亚比米勒。他们说：「他原是我们的弟兄」；
9.en: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”

9.zh: 就从巴力·比利土的庙中取了七十[舍客勒]银子给亚比米勒；亚比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟随他。
9.en: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.

9.zh: 他往俄弗拉到他父亲的家，将他弟兄、耶路·巴力的众子七十人都杀在一块磐石上；只剩下耶路·巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他躲藏了。
9.en: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

9.zh: 示剑人和米罗人都一同聚集，往示剑橡树旁的柱子那里，立亚比米勒为王。
9.en: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

9.zh: 有人将这事告诉约坦，他就去站在基利心山顶上，向众人大声喊叫说：「示剑人哪，你们要听我的话，　神也就听你们的话。
9.en: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

9.zh: 有一时，树木要膏一树为王，管理他们，就去对橄榄树说：『请你作我们的王。』
9.en: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

9.zh: 橄榄树回答说：『我岂肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飘摇在众树之上呢？』
9.en: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

9.zh: 树木对无花果树说：『请你来作我们的王。』
9.en: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’

9.zh: 无花果树回答说：『我岂肯止住所结甜美的果子，飘摇在众树之上呢？』
9.en: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

9.zh: 树木对葡萄树说：『请你来作我们的王。』
9.en: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’

9.zh: 葡萄树回答说：『我岂肯止住使神和人喜乐的新酒，飘摇在众树之上呢？』
9.en: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

9.zh: 众树对荆棘说：『请你来作我们的王。』
9.en: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’

9.zh: 荆棘回答说：『你们若诚诚实实地膏我为王，就要投在我的荫下；不然，愿火从荆棘里出来，烧灭黎巴嫩的香柏树。』
9.en: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’

9.zh: 「现在你们立亚比米勒为王，若按诚实正直善待耶路·巴力和他的全家，这就是酬他的劳。
9.en: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

9.zh: 从前我父冒死为你们争战，救了你们脱离米甸人的手。
9.en: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;

9.zh: 你们如今起来攻击我的父家，将他众子七十人杀在一块磐石上，又立他婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒为示剑人的王；他原是你们的弟兄。
9.en: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

9.zh: 你们如今若按诚实正直待耶路·巴力和他的家，就可因亚比米勒得欢乐，他也可因你们得欢乐；
9.en: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;

9.zh: 不然，愿火从亚比米勒发出，烧灭示剑人和米罗众人，又愿火从示剑人和米罗人中出来，烧灭亚比米勒。」
9.en: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”

9.zh: 约坦因怕他弟兄亚比米勒，就逃跑，来到比珥，住在那里。
9.en: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

9.zh: 亚比米勒管理以色列人三年。
9.en: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

9.zh: 神使恶魔降在亚比米勒和示剑人中间，示剑人就以诡诈待亚比米勒。
9.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

9.zh: 这是要叫耶路·巴力七十个儿子所受的残害归与他们的哥哥亚比米勒，又叫那流他们血的罪归与帮助他杀弟兄的示剑人。
9.en: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

9.zh: 示剑人在山顶上设埋伏，等候亚比米勒。凡从他们那里经过的人，他们就抢夺。有人将这事告诉亚比米勒。
9.en: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

9.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄来到示剑，示剑人都信靠他。
9.en: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

9.zh: 示剑人出城到田间去，摘下葡萄，踹酒，设摆筵宴，进他们神的庙中吃喝，咒诅亚比米勒。
9.en: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

9.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒说：「亚比米勒是谁？示剑是谁？使我们服事他呢？他不是耶路·巴力的儿子吗？他的帮手不是西布勒吗？你们可以服事示剑的父亲哈抹的后裔。我们为何服事亚比米勒呢？
9.en: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?

9.zh: 惟愿这民归我的手下，我就除掉亚比米勒。」迦勒又对亚比米勒说：「增添你的军兵出来吧。」
9.en: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”

9.zh: 邑宰西布勒听见以别的儿子迦勒的话，就发怒，
9.en: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

9.zh: 悄悄地打发人去见亚比米勒，说：「以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄到了示剑，煽惑城中的民攻击你。
9.en: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.

9.zh: 现在你和跟随你的人今夜起来，在田间埋伏。
9.en: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

9.zh: 到早晨太阳一出，你就起来闯城。迦勒和跟随他的人出来攻击你的时候，你便向他们见机而做。」
9.en: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”

9.zh: 于是，亚比米勒和跟随他的众人夜间起来，分作四队，埋伏等候示剑人。
9.en: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

9.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒出去，站在城门口。亚比米勒和跟随他的人从埋伏之处起来。
9.en: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.

9.zh: 迦勒看见那些人，就对西布勒说：「看哪，有人从山顶上下来了。」西布勒说：「你看见山的影子，以为是人。」
9.en: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said to him, “You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.”

9.zh: 迦勒又说：「看哪，有人从高处下来，又有一队从米恶尼尼橡树的路上而来。」
9.en: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”

9.zh: 西布勒对他说：「你曾说，亚比米勒是谁，叫我们服事他？你所[夸]的口在哪里呢？这不是你所藐视的民吗？你现在出去，与他们交战吧！」
9.en: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

9.zh: 于是迦勒率领示剑人出去，与亚比米勒交战。
9.en: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

9.zh: 亚比米勒追赶迦勒；迦勒在他面前逃跑，有许多受伤仆倒的，直到城门。
9.en: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.

9.zh: 亚比米勒住在亚鲁玛。西布勒赶出迦勒和他弟兄，不准他们住在示剑。
9.en: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

9.zh: 次日，民出到田间，有人告诉亚比米勒；
9.en: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

9.zh: 他就把他的人分作三队，埋伏在田间，看见示剑人从城里出来，就起来击杀他们。
9.en: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.

9.zh: 亚比米勒和跟随他的一队向前闯去，站在城门口；那两队直闯到田间，击杀了众人。
9.en: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

9.zh: 亚比米勒整天攻打城，将城夺取，杀了其中的居民，将城拆毁，撒上了盐。
9.en: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

9.zh: 示剑楼的人听见了，就躲入巴力·比利土庙的卫所。
9.en: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.

9.zh: 有人告诉亚比米勒说：「示剑楼的人都聚在一处。」
9.en: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

9.zh: 亚比米勒和跟随他的人就都上撒们山。亚比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根树枝，扛在肩上，对跟随他的人说：「你们看我所行的，也当赶紧照样行。」
9.en: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”

9.zh: 众人就各砍一枝，跟随亚比米勒，把树枝堆在卫所的四围，放火烧了卫所，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千。
9.en: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

9.zh: 亚比米勒到提备斯，向提备斯安营，就攻取了那城。
9.en: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

9.zh: 城中有一座坚固的楼；城里的众人，无论男女，都逃进楼去，关上门，上了楼顶。
9.en: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.

9.zh: 亚比米勒到了楼前攻打，挨近楼门，要用火焚烧。
9.en: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

9.zh: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石抛在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的脑骨。
9.en: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.

9.zh: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，对他说：「拔出你的刀来，杀了我吧！免得人议论我说，他为一个妇人所杀。」于是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。
9.en: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”

9.zh: 以色列人见亚比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。
9.en: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.

9.zh: 这样，　神报应亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶，就是杀了弟兄七十个人的恶。
9.en: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;

9.zh: 示剑人的一切恶，　神也都报应在他们头上；耶路·巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅归到他们身上了。
9.en: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.

10.zh: 亚比米勒以后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子、普瓦的儿子陀拉兴起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法莲山地的沙密。
10.en: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

10.zh: 陀拉作以色列的士师二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。
10.en: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

10.zh: 在他以后有基列人睚珥兴起，作以色列的士师二十二年。
10.en: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.

10.zh: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十匹驴驹。他们有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特·睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。
10.en: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

10.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力和亚斯她录，并亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神，离弃耶和华，不事奉他。
10.en: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.

10.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人和亚扪人的手中。
10.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

10.zh: 从那年起，他们扰害欺压约旦河那边、住亚摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。
10.en: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

10.zh: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大和便雅悯，并以法莲族。以色列人就甚觉窘迫。
10.en: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

10.zh: 以色列人哀求耶和华说：「我们得罪了你；因为离弃了我们　神，去事奉诸巴力。」
10.en: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”

10.zh: 耶和华对以色列人说：「我岂没有[救过你们]脱离埃及人、亚摩利人、亚扪人，和非利士人吗？
10.en: The LORD said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

10.zh: 西顿人、亚玛力人、马云人也都欺压你们；你们哀求我，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。
10.en: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.

10.zh: 你们竟离弃我，事奉别神！所以我不再救你们了。
10.en: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

10.zh: 你们去哀求所选择的神；你们遭遇急难的时候，让他救你们吧！」
10.en: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

10.zh: 以色列人对耶和华说：「我们犯罪了，任凭你随意待我们吧！只求你今日拯救我们。」
10.en: The children of Israel said to the LORD, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”

10.zh: 以色列人就除掉他们中间的外邦神，事奉耶和华。耶和华因以色列人受的苦难，就心中担忧。
10.en: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

10.zh: 当时亚扪人聚集，安营在基列。以色列人也聚集，安营在米斯巴。
10.en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.

10.zh: 基列的民和众首领彼此商议说：「谁能先去攻打亚扪人，谁必作基列一切居民的领袖。」
10.en: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

11.zh: 基列人耶弗他是个大能的勇士，是妓女的儿子。耶弗他是基列所生的。
11.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.

11.zh: 基列的妻也生了几个儿子：他妻所生的儿子长大了，就赶逐耶弗他，说：「你不可在我们父家承受产业，因为你是妓女的儿子。」
11.en: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”

11.zh: 耶弗他就逃避他的弟兄，去住在陀伯地，有些匪徒到他那里聚集，与他一同出入。
11.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.

11.zh: 过了些日子，亚扪人攻打以色列。
11.en: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

11.zh: 亚扪人攻打以色列的时候，基列的长老到陀伯地去，要叫耶弗他回来；
11.en: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

11.zh: 对耶弗他说：「请你来作我们的元帅，我们好与亚扪人争战。」
11.en: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”

11.zh: 耶弗他回答基列的长老说：「从前你们不是恨我、赶逐我出离父家吗？现在你们遭遇急难为何到我这里来呢？」
11.en: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”

11.zh: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说：「现在我们到你这里来，是要你同我们去，与亚扪人争战；你可以作基列一切居民的领袖。」
11.en: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

11.zh: 耶弗他对基列的长老说：「你们叫我回去，与亚扪人争战，耶和华把他交给我，我可以作你们的领袖吗？」
11.en: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them before me, will I be your head?”

11.zh: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说：「有耶和华在你我中间作见证，我们必定照你的话行。」
11.en: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”

11.zh: 于是耶弗他同基列的长老回去，百姓就立耶弗他作领袖、作元帅。耶弗他在米斯巴将自己的一切话陈明在耶和华面前。
11.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.

11.zh: 耶弗他打发使者去见亚扪人的王，说：「你与我有什么相干，竟来到我国中攻打我呢？」
11.en: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”

11.zh: 亚扪人的王回答耶弗他的使者说：「因为以色列人从埃及上来的时候占据我的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到约旦河。现在你要好好地将这[地]归还吧！」
11.en: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”

11.zh: 耶弗他又打发使者去见亚扪人的王，
11.en: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;

11.zh: 对他说：「耶弗他如此说，以色列人并没有占据摩押地和亚扪人的地。
11.en: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

11.zh: 以色列人从埃及上来乃是经过旷野到红海，来到加低斯，
11.en: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

11.zh: 就打发使者去见以东王，说：『求你容我从你的地经过。』以东王却不应允。又照样打发使者去见摩押王，他也不允准。以色列人就住在加低斯。
11.en: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

11.zh: 他们又经过旷野，绕着以东和摩押地，从摩押地的东边过来，在亚嫩河边安营，并没有入摩押的境内，因为亚嫩河是摩押的边界。
11.en: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.

11.zh: 以色列人打发使者去见亚摩利王西宏，就是希实本的王，对他说：『求你容我们从你的地经过，往我们自己的地方去。』
11.en: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’

11.zh: 西宏却不信服以色列人，不容他们经过他的境界，乃招聚他的众民在雅杂安营，与以色列人争战。
11.en: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

11.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神将西宏和他的众民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人就击杀他们，得了亚摩利人的全地：
11.en: The LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

11.zh: 从亚嫩河到雅博河，从旷野直到约旦河。
11.en: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.

11.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神在他百姓以色列面前赶出亚摩利人，你竟要得他们的地吗？
11.en: So now the LORD, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?

11.zh: 你的神基抹所赐你的地你不是得为业吗？耶和华—我们的　神在我们面前所赶出的人，我们就得他的地。
11.en: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever the LORD our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.

11.zh: 难道你比摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒还强吗？他曾与以色列人争竞，或是与他们争战吗？
11.en: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

11.zh: 以色列人住希实本和属希实本的乡村，亚罗珥和属亚罗珥的乡村，并沿亚嫩河的一切城邑，已经有三百年了；在这三百年之内，你们为什么没有取回这些地方呢？
11.en: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?

11.zh: 原来我没有得罪你，你却攻打我，恶待我。愿审判人的耶和华今日在以色列人和亚扪人中间判断是非。」
11.en: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May the LORD the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

11.zh: 但亚扪人的王不肯听耶弗他打发人说的话。
11.en: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

11.zh: 耶和华的灵降在耶弗他身上，他就经过基列和玛拿西，来到基列的米斯巴，又从米斯巴来到亚扪人那里。
11.en: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.

11.zh: 耶弗他就向耶和华许愿，说：「你若将亚扪人交在我手中，
11.en: Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,

11.zh: 我从亚扪人那里平平安安回来的时候，无论什么人，先从我家门出来迎接我，就必归你，我也必将他献上为燔祭。」
11.en: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be the LORD’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”

11.zh: 于是耶弗他往亚扪人那里去，与他们争战；耶和华将他们交在他手中，
11.en: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.

11.zh: 他就大大杀败他们，从亚罗珥到米匿，直到亚备勒·基拉明，攻取了二十座城。这样亚扪人就被以色列人制伏了。
11.en: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

11.zh: 耶弗他回米斯巴到了自己的家，不料，他女儿拿着鼓跳舞出来迎接他，是他独生的，此外无儿无女。
11.en: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

11.zh: 耶弗他看见她，就撕裂衣服，说：「哀哉！我的女儿啊，你使我甚是愁苦，叫我作难了；因为我已经向耶和华开口[许愿]，不能挽回。」
11.en: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I can’t go back.”

11.zh: 他女儿回答说：「父啊，你既向耶和华开口，就当照你口中所说的向我行，因耶和华已经在仇敌亚扪人身上为你报仇」；
11.en: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to the LORD; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because the LORD has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”

11.zh: 又对父亲说：「有一件事求你允准：容我去两个月，与同伴在山上，好哀哭我终为处女。」
11.en: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”

11.zh: 耶弗他说：「你去吧！」就容她去两个月。她便和同伴去了，在山上为她终为处女哀哭。
11.en: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.

11.zh: 两月已满，她回到父亲那里，父亲就照所许的愿向她行了。女儿终身没有亲近男子。
11.en: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel

11.zh: 此后以色列中有个规矩，每年以色列的女子去为基列人耶弗他的女儿哀哭四天。
11.en: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

12.zh: 以法莲人聚集，到了北方，对耶弗他说：「你去与亚扪人争战，为什么没有招我们同去呢？我们必用火烧你和你的房屋。」
12.en: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”

12.zh: 耶弗他对他们说：「我和我的民与亚扪人大大争战；我招你们来，你们竟没有来救我脱离他们的手。
12.en: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.

12.zh: 我见你们不来救我，我就拚命前去攻击亚扪人，耶和华将他们交在我手中。你们今日为什么上我这里来攻打我呢？」
12.en: When I saw that you didn’t save me, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me today, to fight against me?”

12.zh: 于是耶弗他招聚基列人，与以法莲人争战。基列人击杀以法莲人，是因他们说：「你们基列人在以法莲、玛拿西中间，不过是以法莲逃亡的人。」
12.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”

12.zh: 基列人把守约旦河的渡口，不容以法莲人过去。以法莲逃走的人若说：「容我过去。」基列人就问他说：「你是以法莲人不是？」他若说：「不是」，
12.en: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”

12.zh: 就对他说：「你说『示播列』。」以法莲人因为咬不真字音，便说「西播列」。基列人就将他拿住，杀在约旦河的渡口。那时以法莲人被杀的有四万二千人。
12.en: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.

12.zh: 耶弗他作以色列的士师六年。基列人耶弗他死了，葬在基列的一座城里。
12.en: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

12.zh: 耶弗他以后，有伯利恒人以比赞作以色列的士师。
12.en: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

12.zh: 他有三十个儿子，三十个女儿；女儿都嫁出去了。他给众子从外乡娶了三十个媳妇。他作以色列的士师七年。
12.en: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.

12.zh: 以比赞死了，葬在伯利恒。
12.en: Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

12.zh: 以比赞之后，有西布伦人以伦，作以色列的士师十年。
12.en: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

12.zh: 西布伦人以伦死了，葬在西布伦地的亚雅 。
12.en: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

12.zh: 以伦之后，有比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿作以色列的士师。
12.en: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

12.zh: 他有四十个儿子，三十个孙子，骑着七十匹驴驹。押顿作以色列的士师八年。
12.en: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.

12.zh: 比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿死了，葬在以法莲地的比拉顿，在亚玛力人的山地。
12.en: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

13.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华将他们交在非利士人手中四十年。
13.en: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

13.zh: 那时，有一个琐拉人，是属但族的，名叫玛挪亚。他的妻不怀孕，不生育。
13.en: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.

13.zh: 耶和华的使者向那妇人显现，对她说：「向来你不怀孕，不生育，如今你必怀孕生一个儿子。
13.en: The LORD’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

13.zh: 所以你当谨慎，清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃。
13.en: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;

13.zh: 你必怀孕生一个儿子，不可用剃头刀剃他的头，因为这孩子一出胎就归　神作拿细耳人。他必起首拯救以色列人脱离非利士人的手。」
13.en: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”

13.zh: 妇人就回去对丈夫说：「有一个神人到我面前来，他的相貌如　神使者的相貌，甚是可畏。我没有问他从哪里来，他也没有将他的名告诉我，
13.en: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;

13.zh: 却对我说：『你要怀孕生一个儿子，所以清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃；因为这孩子从出胎一直到死，必归　神作拿细耳人。』」
13.en: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”

13.zh: 玛挪亚就祈求耶和华说：「主啊，求你再差遣那神人到我们这里来，好指教我们怎样待这将要生的孩子。」
13.en: Then Manoah entreated the LORD, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”

13.zh: 神应允玛挪亚的话；妇人正坐在田间的时候，　神的使者又到她那里，她丈夫玛挪亚却没有同她在一处。
13.en: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.

13.zh: 妇人急忙跑去告诉丈夫说：「那日到我面前来的人，又向我显现。」
13.en: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me.”

13.zh: 玛挪亚起来跟随他的妻来到那人面前，对他说：「与这妇人说话的就是你吗？」他说：「是我。」
13.en: Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”

13.zh: 玛挪亚说：「愿你的话应验！我们当怎样待这孩子，他后来当怎样呢？」
13.en: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”

13.zh: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说：「我告诉妇人的一切事，她都当谨慎。
13.en: The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

13.zh: 葡萄树所结的都不可吃，清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃。凡我所吩咐的，她都当遵守。」
13.en: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”

13.zh: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说：「求你容我们款留你，好为你预备一只山羊羔。」
13.en: Manoah said to the LORD’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”

13.zh: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说：「你虽然款留我，我却不吃你的食物，你若预备燔祭就当献与耶和华。」原来玛挪亚不知道他是耶和华的使者。
13.en: The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to the LORD.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was the LORD’s angel.

13.zh: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说：「请将你的名告诉我，到你话应验的时候，我们好尊敬你。」
13.en: Manoah said to the LORD’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”

13.zh: 耶和华的使者对他说：「你何必问我的名，我名是奇妙的。」
13.en: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”

13.zh: 玛挪亚将一只山羊羔和素祭在磐石上献与耶和华，[使者]行奇妙的事；玛挪亚和他的妻观看，
13.en: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to the LORD. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.

13.zh: 见火焰从坛上往上升，耶和华的使者在坛上的火焰中也升上去了。玛挪亚和他的妻看见，就俯伏于地。
13.en: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, the LORD’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

13.zh: 耶和华的使者不再向玛挪亚和他的妻显现，玛挪亚才知道他是耶和华的使者。
13.en: But the LORD’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was the LORD’s angel.

13.zh: 玛挪亚对他的妻说：「我们必要死，因为看见了　神。」
